items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Billie used to ride in my car, with Zutty Singleton also, who traveled with the band for a while in the summer of 1938.

ctx.x: You did some traveling in the south with Artie Shaw? When Billie Holiday was in the band, didn’t you?

Yeah. Not much. There was one incident that — Billie used to ride in my car, with Zutty Singleton also, who traveled with the band for a while in the summer of 1938. And we were in Ohio or someplace. But we went into West Virginia. And Zutty knew the area, © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Parkersburg, West Virginia. I’d never been. So he told me where to stop, and there was a nice looking building, a three story building. And it was a hotel, but it was for black people. And he got out, and he said, “Billie, you’d better get out.” And she said, “No.” She said, “I’m going down with the rest of the guys.” He said, “You’ll be sorry. You’re down south.” And she muttered a few words. Anyway we went on down to the hotel and they said, “We’re all full” to her you know. So she got back in the car and I…
